headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty extended gains to eight-month highs; markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 12 November.

why: Indian stock markets (NSE and BSE) are closed today on account of Diwali-Balipratipada.
Trading activity on both major exchanges remains suspended for the local holiday.
During the last trading session, Sensex and Nifty closed at their highest levels in over eight months.
Regular market trading will resume on Thursday, 12 November.
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty 50 surged over 6% across the past five trading sessions prior to the holiday.
India VIX advanced 68% over 47 days, including an 18% rise in the last three weeks.
Individual ownership in NSE-listed companies climbed to a record 19.5% in Q2FY27.
NTPC submitted two applications, leading the second round of coal gasification bids.
summary: Indian equity markets are closed today due to the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday. On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to reach their highest levels in over eight months following a 6% five-session rally. Trading is set to reopen on Thursday, 12 November.
